title: germinate seed
description: A seed = content + germination conditions. This schema validates the parsed frontmatter object. Unknown fields MUST be tolerated (forward-compat / schema accretion). v0.1 matches ONLY on literal soil + tags; triggers/care/applications are human annotation, not match input.

id.description: Stable id for dedupe/precedence; defaults to the filename stem.

seed_type.description: OPEN free-text tag (not a closed enum). E.g. adr, memory, problem-shape, design-token.

soil.description: Contexts where it thrives (repo/path/domain/token). MATCH dimension AND bank router. A soil entry containing '/' is treated as a git path and staleness-checked.

antipatterns.description: Where NOT to plant it. A literal match here SUPPRESSES the seed (visibly).

provenance.description: Where the seed was minted from. Global-bank seeds MUST NOT carry un-redacted internal identifiers (use rosetta handles).

global.description: Opt-in to the global cross-project bank. Default false = local, tenant-scoped.

triggers.description: v0.1: human annotation ONLY, not match input. Reserved for the v0.2 semantic (ARCS) layer.
